import json, tempfile, pathlib, os
import pandas as pd
from igel import Igel
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    p = pathlib.Path(d)
    pd.DataFrame({'a':[1,2,3,4], 'b':[2,4,6,8], 'target':[2,3,4,5]}).to_csv(p/'data.csv', index=False)
    (p/'config.json').write_text(json.dumps({'dataset': {'features': {'include': ['a']}}, 'model': {'type': 'regression', 'algorithm': 'LinearRegression'}, 'target': ['target']}))
    Igel.results_path = p/'results'; Igel.default_model_path = p/'results'/'model.joblib'; Igel.description_file = p/'results'/'description.json'
    Igel(cmd='fit', data_path=str(p/'data.csv'), yaml_path=str(p/'config.json'))
    description = json.loads((p/'results'/'description.json').read_text())
    print('schema exists:', (p/'results'/'feature_schema.joblib').exists())
    print('input features:', description.get('input_features'))
    print('training width:', description['train_data_shape'][1])
